title: People are never checked for floating or feet through the floor
summary: Figures skip the floating check and S.collide only tests bodies in solids: a climber in mid-air, a prone man .45 m up or feet through the floor all pass as 0 issues.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: const lo = lowestPoint(f); if (lo.y - floorY > .03 && !held) warn(f.name + ' floats');   // a manual support check

doc.when: Every shot with people that aren't simply standing/sitting on the floor.
gotchas: Engine fix wanted: a 'support' check (a foot, knee, hand or pelvis within 3 cm of a surface or a declared hold) and floor penetration of feet.

problem.symptom: A figure hangs in the air or its feet sink into the floor, yet the checker reports 0 issues.
problem.cause: Bodies carry noContact; S.collide tests body-in-solid only.
problem.fix: Measure bone heights (?bones=1) and look at crops; add your own support check per figure.
problem.detect: lowest bone y vs the surface under it; visual check of tilted feet.
